Definition: Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites
BiblicalUsage: Baal-zebub was the god of Ekron, and Ahaziah sent messengers to enquire of him when he fell through the lattice of his upper chamber; Elijah met the messengers on the road and asked, is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baal-zebub? The king sent twice more, and the fire of God answered both times.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ahaziah's question is the question of every age: is there not a God in Israel? Elijah's answer still stands — there is, and he is not to be enquired of through a fly-god.
